node.title: Re: system call error
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: This is definitely one of those cases where all of the advice from [id://1180578|here] and [id://1205217|here] applies: First, don't do things like ls and awk in the shell, do them in Perl. For example, instead of ls, the module [mod://Path::Class] is very nice. And for calling the [man://readelf] command, you should use one of the modules I suggest in the first link - such as [mod://IPC::System::Simple]'s capturex, or, if you also need to capture the command's STDERR, maybe [mod://IPC::Run3]. There is example code for both in the first link.
